{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.02

|gr1= Program Flow

|descr= Skips all loop iterations and immediately returns the given value.

|s1= [[breakWith]] return

|p1= return: [[Anything]] - value to be returned when iterations are skipped

|r1= [[Anything]]

|x1= <sqf>
// stops once _i reaches 5 and outputs 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, END
systemChat call {
	for "_i" from 0 to 10 do {
		if (_i == 5) then { breakWith "END"; };
		systemChat str _i;
	};
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[continueWith]] [[break]] [[continue]] [[breakOut]]
}}
